assessment: This study is a valuable observation that deals with the toxic effects of an intermediary in lipid degradation [trans-2-hexadecenal (t-2-hex)] in yeast through modification of mitochondrial protein import via the TOM complex. We find that the claim that the TOM complex is a main target of t-2-hex are supported by solid evidence, however the molecular mechanism remains unclear allowing multiple interpretation. Despite the shortcomings, this study is inspiring for researchers from the organellar, protein trafficking and lipid field and serves as a starting point to further precise and mechanistic analyses of the phenomenon.
